items.q: So I went down there and during the session this other guy was there, George, one of the managers.

ctx.x: So I went down there and during the session this other guy was there, George, one of the managers. And someone told me, he says, “We’re thinking about maybe doing a couple of gigs with this band.” When I first went in there they didn’t even know if they were going to release this. It became “The Seeger Sessions” the record that came out.
It was on television, wasn’t it?
